places.name: Co Chocolat Factory & Cafe
places.description: A farm-to-bar chocolate factory and cafe run by two Dubai sisters, using cacao from their own farms in the Philippines. Watch production through the kitchen window, or book a chocolate-making session where you learn about cacao and mould your own bars; check the factory's site for session days and prices.

places.name: Mawaheb Art Studio & Cafe
places.description: A non-profit art studio for adult artists of determination, with a small cafe open to everyone and artwork for sale. Visitors can drop in for coffee, see the artists' work, and sign up for public art workshops.
